title: Oleg's Portrait
content: Sometimes when I sketch a fellow artist at a restaurant, they return the favor.This isOleg Dergachov. He's a cartoonist, animator, illustrator, and gallery artist who was trained by the Ukrainian Academy. He teaches head drawing and analytical sketching atSyn Studioon Montréal.I am sitting across from him at a sushi place. It is one of those restaurants where everyone is shouting so loud that you can't talk to the person across the table.But that's OK, because artists can talk with their pens and brushes. I love it, thank you, Oleg!-----Oleg's Gallery
